Searches ran out before these could be checked further, so they are unknown and open for a later pass. Facebook pages were not opened. The City's Park Friends list page is a dynamic map with none of these parks in its text. It is not a Friends group in this batch, so no record was written; it was named on the City's March 2022 page. Shofuso Japanese House and Garden and Manayunk Bridge Garden were named on the same City page; the Manayunk friends group is unnamed and has no link, and Shofuso is not a Friends group in this batch. Partners named on the Vernon, Weccacoe, and Wissahickon Neighbors pages are listed in each record's notes with no links captured, so they were not checked.
